en.B: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered:
en.R: Then Eliphaz the Temanite said:

es.B: Entonces Elifaz el temanita respondió:
es.R: Entonces Elifaz el temanita dijo:

fr.L: Et Éliphaz le Témanite répondit et dit :
fr.B: Alors Éliphaz le Témanite répondit :
fr.R: Alors Éliphaz le Témanite a dit :

sw.L: Ndipo Elifazi Mtemani akajibu, akasema:
sw.B: Kisha Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:
sw.R: Kisha Elifazi Mtemani akasema:

vi.L: Ê-li-pha người Thê-man đáp lời và nói:
vi.B: Bấy giờ Ê-li-pha người Thê-man đáp:
vi.R: Ê-li-pha người Thê-man nói:

ko.L: 그러자 데만 사람 엘리바스가 대답하여 말했다.
ko.B: 그러자 데만 사람 엘리바스가 대답했다.
ko.R: 그러자 데만 사람 엘리바스가 말했다.

decisions.choice: Eliphaz answers Job: the second round of speeches begins
decisions.reason: Job's reply to Zophar (chapters 12-14) closes the first round of speeches. Eliphaz, who spoke first in chapters 4-5, now opens the second round. As in 4:1, the words that introduce a speech are prose; the speech itself (15:2-35) is poetry.

decisions.choice: the Temanite: from Teman, in Edom
decisions.reason: Teman was a clan and region of Edom, named for a grandson of Esau (Genesis 36:11, 15). It was known for its wise men (Jeremiah 49:7; Obadiah 8-9).

decisions.choice: answered (Balanced), said (Readable), without "and said"
decisions.reason: Hebrew introduces speech with two verbs, "answered and said". Literal keeps both; Balanced and Readable say it once, with the same wording at every speech introduction in Job.

decisions.choice: « répondit et dit » (L), « répondit » (B): passé simple; « a dit » (R): passé composé
decisions.reason: The speech introduction is narrative, so French uses the passé simple at Literal and Balanced and the passé composé at Readable; Eliphaz's speech itself is in the present and passé composé.

source.text: הֶֽחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַֽעַת־ר֑וּחַ וִֽימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [Is it that] a wise [one] answers knowledge of wind, and fills [with the] east wind his belly?

en.L: Should a wise [person] answer [with] knowledge of wind, \q and fill his belly [with] the east wind?
en.B: Should a wise person answer with windy knowledge \q and fill his belly with the east wind?
en.R: Would a wise person answer with empty talk? \q Would he fill himself up with hot desert wind?

es.L: ¿Responderá un sabio [con] conocimiento de viento, \q y llenará su vientre [con] el viento del este?
es.B: ¿Debe un sabio responder con un saber de viento \q y llenarse el vientre de viento del este?
es.R: ¿Respondería un sabio con palabras vacías? \q ¿Se llenaría de viento caliente del desierto?

fr.L: Un sage répondra-t-il [par] un savoir de vent, \q et remplira-t-il son ventre [du] vent d’est ?
fr.B: Un sage doit-il répondre par un savoir plein de vent \q et se remplir le ventre de vent d’est ?
fr.R: Un sage répondrait-il par des paroles vides ? \q Se remplirait-il de vent brûlant du désert ?

sw.L: Je, mwenye hekima atajibu [kwa] maarifa ya upepo, \q na kulijaza tumbo lake [kwa] upepo wa mashariki?
sw.B: Je, mwenye hekima ajibu kwa maarifa matupu kama upepo \q na kujaza tumbo lake upepo wa mashariki?
sw.R: Je, mtu mwenye hekima angejibu kwa maneno matupu? \q Je, angejijaza upepo wa joto wa jangwani?

vi.L: Người khôn ngoan há đáp bằng tri thức của gió, \q và làm đầy bụng mình [bằng] gió đông sao?
vi.B: Người khôn ngoan lẽ nào lại đáp bằng sự hiểu biết rỗng như gió \q và nhét đầy bụng mình gió đông?
vi.R: Người khôn ngoan có trả lời bằng những lời rỗng tuếch không? \q Người ấy có tự làm mình đầy gió nóng sa mạc không?

ko.L: 지혜로운 자가 바람 같은 지식으로 대답하며, \q 동풍으로 자기 배를 채우겠소?
ko.B: 지혜로운 사람이 바람 같은 지식으로 대답하고 \q 동풍으로 배를 채워서야 되겠소?
ko.R: 지혜로운 사람이 빈말로 대답하겠소? \q 사막의 뜨거운 바람으로 자기 속을 채우겠소?

decisions.choice: knowledge of wind: empty knowledge, words with nothing in them
decisions.reason: Wind stands for what is empty and useless (7:7; 16:3; Ecclesiastes 1:14). Bildad called Job's words "a mighty wind" (8:2), and Job called the friends' words wind (6:26); Eliphaz turns the charge back on Job.

decisions.choice: the east wind in his belly: hot, harmful words from deep inside
decisions.reason: The east wind (qadim) is the scorching wind off the desert that withers plants and does damage (27:21; Genesis 41:6; Hosea 13:15). The belly is the inner self where thoughts form (32:18-19). Job's words, Eliphaz says, are not only empty but harmful.

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer no
decisions.reason: The question marker opens a question a wise person would answer "no" to. Job claimed to know as much as his friends (12:3; 13:2); Eliphaz suggests that a truly wise man would not talk as he does.

decisions.choice: empty talk; hot desert wind
alternatives: knowledge of wind; the east wind
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pictures mean (m1, m2): empty words, and a wind that scorches.

decisions.choice: 하오체 with "그대" (Eliphaz to Job) only in the lines he addresses to Job (verses 2-13, 17); plain 해라체 for the proverbial and descriptive lines (verses 14-16, 18-35)
decisions.reason: Job and his friends speak to each other as respected equals, so direct address, questions to Job and commands are in 하오체 with "그대". The general sayings and the long portrait of the wicked are not addressed to Job, so Korean gives them the plain style of written poetry.

source.text: הוֹכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא־יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Arguing with a word [that] not is of use, and words [that] not he profits by them?

en.L: Arguing with talk [that] is of no use, \q and with words by which he does no good?
en.B: Should he argue with useless talk, \q with words that do no good?
en.R: Should he argue with talk that is useless, \q with words that help no one?

es.L: ¿Discutiendo con palabras que no sirven, \q y con dichos con los que no hace ningún bien?
es.B: ¿Debe argumentar con charla inútil, \q con palabras que no hacen ningún bien?
es.R: ¿Debe discutir con palabras que no sirven para nada, \q con palabras que no ayudan a nadie?

fr.L: Plaider avec un discours [qui] ne sert à rien, \q et avec des mots par lesquels il ne fait aucun bien ?
fr.B: Doit-il plaider avec des propos inutiles, \q avec des paroles qui ne servent à rien ?
fr.R: Doit-il discuter avec des paroles qui ne servent à rien, \q avec des mots qui n’aident personne ?

sw.L: Kubishana kwa maneno [yasiyo] na faida, \q na kwa maneno ambayo kwayo hafanyi jema?
sw.B: Je, abishane kwa maneno yasiyofaa, \q kwa maneno yasiyoleta faida yoyote?
sw.R: Je, abishane kwa maneno yasiyo na maana, \q kwa maneno yasiyomsaidia mtu yeyote?

vi.L: Tranh luận bằng lời [mà] chẳng ích gì, \q và bằng những lời mà [người ấy] chẳng làm được điều tốt nào?
vi.B: Lẽ nào người ấy lại biện luận bằng những lời vô dụng, \q bằng những lời chẳng đem lại ích lợi gì?
vi.R: Người ấy có nên tranh cãi bằng những lời vô ích, \q bằng những lời chẳng giúp được ai không?

ko.L: 쓸모없는 말로 변론하며, \q 아무 유익도 주지 못하는 말들로 [변론하겠소]?
ko.B: 쓸데없는 말로 따지고 \q 아무 도움도 안 되는 말을 늘어놓겠소?
ko.R: 아무 쓸모없는 말로 따지겠소? \q 누구에게도 도움이 안 되는 말로 따지겠소?

decisions.choice: arguing: the question of verse 2 goes on
decisions.reason: The verb is an infinitive, a form without a person. It carries on the question of verse 2: should a wise person argue in this way?

decisions.choice: argue: plead a case, as in court
decisions.reason: The verb (yakach) means to argue a case or to set someone right (13:3, 15; 9:33). Job has said he wants to argue his case with God (13:3); Eliphaz says his arguments are worthless.

decisions.choice: Should he
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the infinitive a full question with a subject (m1); Literal keeps the bare form.

source.text: אַף־אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי־אֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Even you, you break fear, and you diminish meditation before God.

en.L: But you, you are doing away with fear, \q and you hinder devotion before God.
en.B: But you are doing away with the fear of God \q and hindering devotion before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: You are destroying respect for God \q and getting in the way of prayer.

es.L: Pero tú, tú anulas el temor, \q y menoscabas la devoción delante de Dios.
es.B: Pero tú estás acabando con el temor de Dios \q y estorbando la devoción delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Estás destruyendo el respeto a Dios \q y estorbando la oración.

fr.L: Mais toi, tu anéantis la crainte, \q et tu entraves la méditation devant Dieu.
fr.B: Mais toi, tu détruis la crainte de Dieu \q et tu entraves la piété devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Tu détruis le respect de Dieu \q et tu empêches la prière.

sw.L: Lakini wewe, wewe unaivunja hofu, \q na unaizuia tafakari mbele za Mungu.
sw.B: Lakini wewe unaondoa kumcha Mungu \q na kuzuia ibada mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Unaharibu heshima kwa Mungu \q na kuzuia maombi.

vi.L: Còn anh, chính anh hủy bỏ sự kính sợ, \q và cản trở sự suy niệm trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Còn anh, anh đang hủy bỏ lòng kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời \q và cản trở sự sùng kính trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Anh đang phá hủy lòng tôn kính Đức Chúa Trời \q và cản trở sự cầu nguyện.

ko.L: 그런데 그대는, 그대는 경외심을 없애고, \q 하나님 앞에서 묵상을 막고 있소.
ko.B: 그런데 그대는 하나님을 경외하는 마음을 없애고 \q 그분 앞에서 드리는 경건을 가로막고 있소.
ko.R: 그대는 하나님을 존경하는 마음을 무너뜨리고 \q 기도를 가로막고 있소.

decisions.choice: fear: reverence for God, the fear of God
decisions.reason: Fear (yir'ah) standing alone here means the fear of God, a person's reverence and faith, as when Eliphaz asked, "Is not your fear your confidence?" (4:6; see 1:1).

decisions.choice: meditation: devout thought and prayer before God
decisions.reason: Sichah is quiet reflection or prayer (Psalm 119:97, 99). The related word sich is used for Job's "complaint" (7:13; 10:1); here, with "before God", it is the devotion that Job's words, in Eliphaz's view, are undermining.

decisions.choice: doing away with: breaking, making void
decisions.reason: The verb (parar) is used of breaking a covenant or annulling a vow (Numbers 30:9; Psalm 119:126). Eliphaz says Job's talk makes reverence for God empty, for himself and perhaps for those who hear him.

decisions.choice: the fear of God
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "of God" to show what fear is meant (m1). Literal keeps the single word.

decisions.choice: respect for God; prayer
decisions.reason: Readable says "respect for God", as the book-wide choices allow for this phrase, and "prayer" for the devotion of m2.

source.text: כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲוֺנְךָ֣ פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For teaches your iniquity your mouth, and you choose [the] tongue of [the] crafty.

en.L: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, \q and you choose [the] tongue of [the] crafty.
en.B: For your guilt instructs your mouth, \q and you choose the language of the crafty.
en.R: Your sin is what puts these words in your mouth. \q You have chosen to talk like a clever cheat.

es.L: Porque tu iniquidad instruye tu boca, \q y escoges [la] lengua de [los] astutos.
es.B: Porque tu culpa enseña a tu boca, \q y eliges el lenguaje de los astutos.
es.R: Tu pecado es lo que pone esas palabras en tu boca. \q Has decidido hablar como un tramposo astuto.

fr.L: Car ton iniquité enseigne ta bouche, \q et tu choisis [la] langue des rusés.
fr.B: Car ta faute instruit ta bouche, \q et tu choisis le langage des rusés.
fr.R: C’est ton péché qui te met ces paroles dans la bouche. \q Tu as choisi de parler comme un tricheur habile.

sw.L: Kwa maana uovu wako hufundisha kinywa chako, \q nawe wachagua ulimi wa wenye hila.
sw.B: Kwa maana hatia yako inakifundisha kinywa chako, \q nawe unachagua lugha ya wajanja.
sw.R: Dhambi yako ndiyo inayoweka maneno haya kinywani mwako. \q Umeamua kuongea kama mdanganyifu mjanja.

vi.L: Vì tội ác của anh dạy miệng anh, \q và anh chọn lưỡi của kẻ xảo quyệt.
vi.B: Vì tội lỗi của anh dạy miệng anh nói, \q và anh chọn lời lẽ của kẻ gian xảo.
vi.R: Chính tội lỗi của anh đặt những lời ấy vào miệng anh. \q Anh đã chọn ăn nói như một kẻ lừa đảo khôn lỏi.

ko.L: 그대의 죄악이 그대의 입을 가르치니, \q 그대는 간교한 자들의 혀를 택하였소.
ko.B: 그대의 죄가 그대 입을 가르치니, \q 그대는 교활한 자들의 말을 골라 쓰고 있소.
ko.R: 그대의 죄가 그대 입에 이런 말을 넣어 주고 있소. \q 그대는 약삭빠른 사기꾼처럼 말하기로 했소.

decisions.choice: your iniquity teaches your mouth: sin is the source of Job's words
alternatives: your mouth makes known your iniquity
decisions.reason: Either noun could be the subject of "teaches". Most likely sin is the teacher: Job's speech comes from his guilt. Read the other way, Job's mouth shows his sin. Verse 6 goes on to say that his own mouth condemns him.

decisions.choice: the crafty: shrewd, scheming people
decisions.reason: The word ('arum) can mean prudent (Proverbs 12:16), but here, as in 5:12, it is the scheming kind. It is the word used of the serpent in Genesis 3:1.

decisions.choice: iniquity: wrongdoing and the guilt it brings
decisions.reason: 'Avon covers both the wrong done and the guilt that follows. Eliphaz now says outright what he only hinted at in chapters 4-5: Job is guilty.

decisions.choice: two plain sentences
decisions.reason: Readable states the sense of m1 and the picture of the crafty tongue in plain words.

source.text: יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ֣ פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא־אָ֑נִי וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ־בָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Condemns you your mouth and not I, and your lips testify against you.

en.L: Your mouth condemns you, and not I, \q and your lips testify against you.
en.B: Your own mouth condemns you, not I; \q your own lips testify against you.
en.R: I do not need to prove you guilty; your own words do that. \q What you say is evidence against you.

es.L: Tu boca te condena, y no yo, \q y tus labios testifican contra ti.
es.B: Tu propia boca te condena, no yo; \q tus propios labios testifican contra ti.
es.R: No hace falta que yo demuestre tu culpa; tus propias palabras lo hacen. \q Lo que dices es prueba contra ti.

fr.L: Ta bouche te condamne, et non moi, \q et tes lèvres témoignent contre toi.
fr.B: C’est ta propre bouche qui te condamne, non pas moi ; \q tes propres lèvres témoignent contre toi.
fr.R: Je n’ai pas besoin de prouver que tu es coupable : tes propres paroles le font. \q Ce que tu dis est une preuve contre toi.

sw.L: Kinywa chako kinakuhukumu, wala si mimi, \q na midomo yako inashuhudia dhidi yako.
sw.B: Kinywa chako mwenyewe kinakuhukumu, si mimi; \q midomo yako mwenyewe inatoa ushahidi dhidi yako.
sw.R: Sihitaji kuthibitisha kwamba una hatia; maneno yako mwenyewe yanafanya hivyo. \q Unayosema ni ushahidi dhidi yako.

vi.L: Miệng anh kết án anh, chứ không phải tôi, \q và môi anh làm chứng chống lại anh.
vi.B: Chính miệng anh kết tội anh, chứ không phải tôi; \q chính môi anh làm chứng chống lại anh.
vi.R: Tôi chẳng cần chứng minh anh có tội; chính lời anh đã làm điều đó. \q Những gì anh nói là bằng chứng chống lại anh.

ko.L: 그대의 입이 그대를 정죄하지, 내가 아니오. \q 그대의 입술이 그대에게 불리하게 증언하오.
ko.B: 나 아니라 그대의 입이 그대를 정죄하고, \q 그대의 입술이 그대를 거슬러 증언하오.
ko.R: 그대가 죄 있음을 내가 증명할 필요도 없소. 그대 자신의 말이 그렇게 하고 있소. \q 그대가 하는 말이 그대에게 불리한 증거요.

decisions.choice: condemns: declares guilty, as a judge does
decisions.reason: The verb (rasha', causative) is a court word, to declare someone in the wrong; it is the opposite of being in the right (9:2).

decisions.choice: Eliphaz turns Job's own words on him
decisions.reason: Job said, "Though I am in the right, my own mouth would condemn me" (9:20). Eliphaz uses the same words: Job's mouth does condemn him.

decisions.choice: testify against you: answer as a witness
decisions.reason: To "answer against" someone is to give evidence against him in court (Exodus 20:16; 1 Samuel 12:3).

decisions.choice: I do not need to prove you guilty
decisions.reason: Readable spells out "and not I": Eliphaz needs no other witness.

source.text: הֲרִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [Were you] first [as a] human born, and before [the] hills were you brought forth?

en.L: Were you born [as the] first human being, \q and were you brought forth before [the] hills?
en.B: Were you the first human being ever born? \q Were you brought forth before the hills?
en.R: Do you think you were the very first person ever born? \q Were you born before the hills were made?

es.L: ¿Naciste tú [como el] primer ser humano, \q y fuiste dado a luz antes que [los] collados?
es.B: ¿Fuiste tú el primer ser humano que nació? \q ¿Fuiste engendrado antes que las colinas?
es.R: ¿Crees que fuiste la primera persona que nació? \q ¿Naciste antes de que existieran las colinas?

fr.L: Es-tu né [comme le] premier humain, \q et as-tu été enfanté avant [les] collines ?
fr.B: Es-tu le premier être humain qui soit né ? \q As-tu été enfanté avant les collines ?
fr.R: Crois-tu que tu es la toute première personne née ? \q Es-tu né avant que les collines existent ?

sw.L: Je, ulizaliwa [kama] mwanadamu wa kwanza, \q nawe ulizaliwa kabla ya vilima?
sw.B: Je, wewe ndiwe mwanadamu wa kwanza kuzaliwa? \q Je, ulizaliwa kabla ya vilima?
sw.R: Je, unadhani wewe ndiye mtu wa kwanza kabisa kuzaliwa? \q Je, ulizaliwa kabla vilima havijaumbwa?

vi.L: Anh có phải được sinh ra [là] người đầu tiên, \q và được dựng nên trước [các] đồi không?
vi.B: Anh có phải là người đầu tiên được sinh ra chăng? \q Anh đã được sinh ra trước các ngọn đồi sao?
vi.R: Anh nghĩ mình là người đầu tiên được sinh ra sao? \q Anh có mặt trước khi núi đồi được dựng nên à?

ko.L: 그대가 첫 사람으로 태어났소? \q 언덕들보다 먼저 났소?
ko.B: 그대가 맨 처음 태어난 사람이오? \q 언덕들이 생기기 전에 그대가 났소?
ko.R: 그대가 세상에서 맨 처음 태어난 사람이라고 생각하오? \q 언덕들이 만들어지기 전에 그대가 태어났소?

decisions.choice: the first human: Adam, who was there from the start
decisions.reason: The first human ('adam) points to Adam in Genesis 2. Eliphaz asks with scorn whether Job thinks he was present at the beginning and so knows more than anyone else.

decisions.choice: brought forth before the hills: like Wisdom in Proverbs 8
decisions.reason: In Proverbs 8:25 Wisdom says, "before the hills I was brought forth", with the same verb and noun. Eliphaz mocks Job as if he claimed to be as old as wisdom itself.

decisions.choice: a mocking question that expects the answer no
decisions.reason: The question marker opens a question with an obvious answer; verses 7-9 are a string of such questions.

source.text: הַבְס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְתִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣יךָ חָכְמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] council of God do you listen, and do you draw to yourself wisdom?

en.L: Have you listened in [the] council of God, \q and do you limit wisdom to yourself?
en.B: Do you listen in on God's council? \q Do you keep wisdom all to yourself?
en.R: Have you been listening in on God's private meetings in heaven? \q Do you think you are the only one who is wise?

es.L: ¿En [el] consejo de Dios escuchaste, \q y reservas para ti la sabiduría?
es.B: ¿Escuchas tú en el consejo de Dios? \q ¿Te guardas la sabiduría solo para ti?
es.R: ¿Has estado escuchando a escondidas las reuniones privadas de Dios en el cielo? \q ¿Crees que eres el único sabio?

fr.L: As-tu écouté dans [le] conseil de Dieu, \q et retiens-tu la sagesse pour toi ?
fr.B: Écoutes-tu ce qui se dit au conseil de Dieu ? \q Gardes-tu la sagesse pour toi seul ?
fr.R: As-tu écouté en secret les réunions privées de Dieu dans le ciel ? \q Crois-tu être le seul à être sage ?

sw.L: Je, ulisikiliza katika baraza la Mungu, \q nawe unaizuia hekima kwa ajili yako?
sw.B: Je, unasikiliza katika baraza la siri la Mungu? \q Je, unajiwekea hekima yote peke yako?
sw.R: Je, umekuwa ukisikiliza kwa siri mikutano ya Mungu huko mbinguni? \q Je, unadhani wewe peke yako ndiye mwenye hekima?

vi.L: Anh có nghe trong hội đồng của Đức Chúa Trời, \q và giữ khôn ngoan cho riêng mình không?
vi.B: Anh có được nghe trong hội đồng kín của Đức Chúa Trời chăng? \q Anh giữ sự khôn ngoan cho riêng mình sao?
vi.R: Anh đã nghe lén những buổi họp kín của Đức Chúa Trời trên trời sao? \q Anh tưởng chỉ mình anh là khôn ngoan sao?

ko.L: 그대가 하나님의 회의에서 들었소? \q 지혜를 그대 혼자 차지하고 있소?
ko.B: 그대가 하나님의 회의에 끼어 엿들었소? \q 지혜를 그대 혼자만 가졌소?
ko.R: 그대가 하늘에서 하나님께서 여시는 비밀 회의를 엿들었소? \q 그대 혼자만 지혜롭다고 생각하오?

decisions.choice: the council of God: his inner circle, where his plans are made
decisions.reason: Sod is a circle of trusted friends and what is said there. The council of God is the gathering of heavenly beings around him (Psalm 89:8; Jeremiah 23:18, 22), like the scene in Job 1:6. Only someone who stood there could know God's purposes.

decisions.choice: draw to yourself: keep it all for yourself
decisions.reason: The verb (gara') means to take away or reduce, as in verse 4. Here, with "to yourself", it pictures Job hoarding wisdom as if no one else had any.

decisions.choice: God's private meetings in heaven
decisions.reason: Readable explains where the council meets and that it is closed to outsiders (m1).

source.text: מַה־יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא־עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: What do you know and not we know? [What] do you understand and not with us [is] it?

en.L: What do you know that we do not know? \q [What] do you understand that is not with us?
en.B: What do you know that we do not know? \q What do you understand that we do not?
en.R: What do you know that we do not know? \q What do you understand that we do not understand?

es.L: ¿Qué sabes tú que no sepamos nosotros? \q ¿[Qué] entiendes que no [esté] con nosotros?
es.B: ¿Qué sabes tú que nosotros no sepamos? \q ¿Qué entiendes tú que nosotros no entendamos?
es.R: ¿Qué sabes tú que nosotros no sepamos? \q ¿Qué cosa entiendes tú que nosotros no podamos entender?

fr.L: Que sais-tu que nous ne sachions pas ? \q [Que] comprends-tu qui ne soit pas avec nous ?
fr.B: Que sais-tu que nous ne sachions pas ? \q Que comprends-tu que nous ne comprenions pas ?
fr.R: Qu’est-ce que tu sais et que nous ne savons pas ? \q Qu’est-ce que tu comprends et que nous ne comprenons pas ?

sw.L: Unajua nini ambacho sisi hatukijui? \q [Unafahamu nini] ambacho hakipo kwetu?
sw.B: Unajua nini ambacho sisi hatujui? \q Unaelewa nini ambacho sisi hatuelewi?
sw.R: Ni kitu gani unachojua ambacho sisi hatukijui? \q Ni kitu gani unachoelewa ambacho sisi hatukielewi?

vi.L: Anh biết điều gì mà chúng tôi không biết? \q Anh hiểu [điều gì] mà không có nơi chúng tôi?
vi.B: Anh biết điều gì mà chúng tôi không biết? \q Anh hiểu điều gì mà chúng tôi không hiểu?
vi.R: Có điều gì anh biết mà chúng tôi không biết? \q Có điều gì anh hiểu mà chúng tôi không hiểu?

ko.L: 그대가 무엇을 알기에 우리는 모르오? \q 그대가 무엇을 깨닫기에 우리에게는 없소?
ko.B: 우리가 모르는 무엇을 그대가 안다는 것이오? \q 우리가 깨닫지 못하는 무엇을 그대가 깨닫는다는 것이오?
ko.R: 우리는 모르는데 그대만 아는 것이 무엇이오? \q 우리는 이해하지 못하는데 그대만 이해하는 것이 무엇이오?

decisions.choice: Eliphaz throws Job's claim back at him
decisions.reason: Job said, "What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you" (13:2; compare 12:3). Eliphaz turns the words around.

decisions.choice: that we do not
decisions.reason: "Not with us" means "that we do not have"; Balanced and Readable say it with the plain verb.

source.text: גַּם־שָׂ֣ב גַּם־יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵאָבִ֣יךָ יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Both [the] gray-haired and [the] aged [are] among us, older than your father [in] days.

en.L: Both [the] gray-haired and [the] aged [are] among us, \q older than your father in days.
en.B: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side, \q people older than your father.
en.R: We have old and gray-haired people on our side, \q people even older than your father.

es.L: Tanto [el] canoso como [el] anciano [están] entre nosotros, \q mayores en días que tu padre.
es.B: Tanto los canosos como los ancianos están de nuestro lado, \q gente mayor que tu padre.
es.R: Tenemos de nuestro lado a gente anciana y canosa, \q gente aún mayor que tu padre.

fr.L: Et l’homme aux cheveux blancs et le vieillard [sont] parmi nous, \q plus âgés que ton père en jours.
fr.B: Les têtes grises et les vieillards sont de notre côté, \q des gens plus âgés que ton père.
fr.R: Nous avons de notre côté des gens âgés aux cheveux blancs, \q des gens encore plus vieux que ton père.

sw.L: Wenye mvi na wazee [wako] kati yetu, \q wakubwa kwa siku kuliko baba yako.
sw.B: Wenye mvi na wazee wako upande wetu, \q watu wakubwa kuliko baba yako.
sw.R: Tuna wazee wenye mvi upande wetu, \q watu wakubwa hata kuliko baba yako.

vi.L: Cả người tóc bạc lẫn người già cả [đều] ở giữa chúng tôi, \q cao tuổi hơn cha anh.
vi.B: Những người tóc bạc và những bậc cao niên đứng về phía chúng tôi, \q những người lớn tuổi hơn cả cha anh.
vi.R: Chúng tôi có những người già tóc bạc đứng về phía mình, \q những người còn lớn tuổi hơn cha anh.

ko.L: 백발노인도, 늙은이도 우리 가운데 [있으니], \q 그대 아버지보다 나이가 많소.
ko.B: 백발이 된 사람들과 나이 든 사람들이 우리 편이오. \q 그대 아버지보다 나이 많은 이들이오.
ko.R: 우리 편에는 나이 많고 머리가 센 사람들이 있소. \q 그대 아버지보다도 나이가 많은 사람들이오.

decisions.choice: age stands for wisdom
decisions.reason: In Israel and among its neighbors, long life and experience were held to bring wisdom (12:12; 32:7). Eliphaz claims the weight of the old teaching for his side.

decisions.choice: among us: on our side, with us
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean that one of the friends, perhaps Eliphaz, is older than Job's father, or more generally that the old men of the past agree with them. Either way the wisdom of age backs the friends.

decisions.choice: on our side
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of m2, so the line does not seem to say that old people are standing among the friends.

source.text: הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ תַּנְחֻמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: [Too] small for you [are the] consolations of God, and a word in gentleness with you?

en.L: Are the consolations of God too small for you, \q and a word [spoken] gently with you?
en.B: Are God's comforts too small for you, \q or a word spoken gently to you?
en.R: Is the comfort God offers not enough for you? \q Are gentle words not enough?

es.L: ¿Son poca cosa para ti las consolaciones de Dios, \q y una palabra [dicha] con dulzura contigo?
es.B: ¿Te parecen poco los consuelos de Dios, \q o una palabra dicha con suavidad?
es.R: ¿No te basta el consuelo que Dios te ofrece? \q ¿No te bastan unas palabras amables?

fr.L: Les consolations de Dieu sont-elles trop peu pour toi, \q et une parole [dite] avec douceur envers toi ?
fr.B: Les consolations de Dieu sont-elles trop peu de chose pour toi, \q ou une parole dite avec douceur ?
fr.R: Le réconfort que Dieu t’offre ne te suffit-il pas ? \q Des paroles douces ne te suffisent-elles pas ?

sw.L: Je, faraja za Mungu ni chache mno kwako, \q na neno [lililosemwa] kwa upole nawe?
sw.B: Je, faraja za Mungu ni ndogo mno kwako, \q au neno lililosemwa kwako kwa upole?
sw.R: Je, faraja anayokupa Mungu haikutoshi? \q Je, maneno ya upole hayakutoshi?

vi.L: Sự an ủi của Đức Chúa Trời có quá nhỏ đối với anh, \q và lời [nói] dịu dàng với anh [cũng vậy] sao?
vi.B: Những lời an ủi của Đức Chúa Trời là quá ít đối với anh sao, \q hay một lời nói dịu dàng với anh cũng vậy?
vi.R: Sự an ủi Đức Chúa Trời ban cho anh chưa đủ sao? \q Những lời dịu dàng chưa đủ với anh sao?

ko.L: 하나님의 위로가 그대에게 작소? \q 그대에게 부드럽게 [한] 말이 [작소]?
ko.B: 하나님의 위로가 그대에게 하찮소? \q 그대에게 부드럽게 건넨 말이 하찮소?
ko.R: 하나님께서 주시는 위로가 그대에게는 부족하오? \q 다정한 말이 부족하오?

decisions.choice: the consolations of God: the comfort God offers, here through the friends' words
decisions.reason: Eliphaz most likely means his own first speech: its gentle opening (4:2) and its promise that God heals those he disciplines (5:17-26). He presents the friends' counsel as God's own comfort, which Job has brushed aside.

decisions.choice: gently: softly, with care
decisions.reason: The word ('at) means gently or slowly (2 Samuel 18:5; Isaiah 8:6). Eliphaz claims the friends have spoken kindly; Job has called them "worthless physicians" (13:4).

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer no
decisions.reason: The question asks whether these comforts are really too little for Job, implying that they are not and that he is wrong to refuse them.

decisions.choice: not enough
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "too small" means here.

source.text: מַה־יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּֽמַה־יִּרְזְמ֥וּן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Why does it carry you away, your heart, and why do they flash, your eyes,

en.L: Why does your heart carry you away, \q and why do your eyes flash,
en.B: Why does your heart carry you away, \q and why do your eyes flash,
en.R: Why do you let your feelings run away with you? \q Why do your eyes flash with anger?

es.L: ¿Por qué te arrebata tu corazón, \q y por qué centellean tus ojos,
es.B: ¿Por qué te dejas arrastrar por tu corazón, \q y por qué echan chispas tus ojos,
es.R: ¿Por qué te dejas llevar por tus sentimientos? \q ¿Por qué te brillan los ojos de ira?

fr.L: Pourquoi ton cœur t’emporte-t-il, \q et pourquoi tes yeux lancent-ils des éclairs,
fr.B: Pourquoi ton cœur t’emporte-t-il, \q pourquoi tes yeux jettent-ils des éclairs,
fr.R: Pourquoi te laisses-tu emporter par tes sentiments ? \q Pourquoi tes yeux brillent-ils de colère ?

sw.L: Kwa nini moyo wako unakuchukua, \q na kwa nini macho yako yanametameta,
sw.B: Kwa nini moyo wako unakupeleka mbali, \q na kwa nini macho yako yanawaka,
sw.R: Kwa nini unaziacha hisia zako zikutawale? \q Kwa nini macho yako yanawaka kwa hasira?

vi.L: Sao lòng anh cuốn anh đi, \q và sao mắt anh long lên,
vi.B: Sao anh để lòng mình lôi cuốn, \q sao mắt anh lại quắc lên,
vi.R: Sao anh để cảm xúc lôi anh đi? \q Sao mắt anh long lên giận dữ?

ko.L: 어찌하여 그대의 마음이 그대를 휩쓸어 가고, \q 어찌하여 그대의 눈이 번뜩여서,
ko.B: 어찌하여 그대는 마음에 휩쓸리고, \q 어찌하여 그대의 눈은 그렇게 번뜩여서,
ko.R: 어찌하여 그대는 감정에 휩쓸리오? \q 어찌하여 눈을 부릅뜨고 화를 내오?

decisions.choice: your heart carries you away: your feelings sweep you along
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and will. To be carried away by it is to let passion overrule good sense.

decisions.choice: flash: your eyes blaze with anger
decisions.reason: The verb (razam) is found only here in the Bible, and its sense is not certain. A similar verb in Aramaic and later Hebrew means to hint with the eyes. Most likely the eyes flash with anger; some take it as a scornful rolling or winking of the eyes.

decisions.choice: the question runs on into verse 13
decisions.reason: The two "why" questions lead to verse 13, which says what the passion leads to: turning against God. Literal and Balanced end the verse with a comma; Readable makes the verses separate questions.

decisions.choice: with anger
decisions.reason: Readable names the feeling the flashing eyes most likely show (m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑ךָ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ מִלִּֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: That you turn against God your spirit, and you bring out from your mouth words?

en.L: that you turn your spirit against God, \q and bring out words from your mouth?
en.B: so that you turn your anger against God \q and let such words come out of your mouth?
en.R: Why do you turn your anger against God \q and let such words come out of your mouth?

es.L: para que vuelvas contra Dios tu espíritu \q y saques de tu boca palabras?
es.B: hasta volver tu enojo contra Dios \q y dejar salir tales palabras de tu boca?
es.R: ¿Por qué vuelves tu enojo contra Dios \q y dejas salir tales palabras de tu boca?

fr.L: que tu tournes ton esprit contre Dieu, \q et fasses sortir de ta bouche des paroles ?
fr.B: au point de tourner ta colère contre Dieu \q et de laisser sortir de telles paroles de ta bouche ?
fr.R: Pourquoi tournes-tu ta colère contre Dieu \q et laisses-tu sortir de telles paroles de ta bouche ?

sw.L: hata ukaigeuza roho yako dhidi ya Mungu, \q na kutoa maneno kinywani mwako?
sw.B: hata ukaigeuza hasira yako dhidi ya Mungu \q na kuacha maneno kama hayo yatoke kinywani mwako?
sw.R: Kwa nini unageuza hasira yako dhidi ya Mungu \q na kuacha maneno kama hayo yatoke kinywani mwako?

vi.L: khiến anh quay tâm thần mình chống lại Đức Chúa Trời, \q và để lời lẽ tuôn ra từ miệng anh?
vi.B: đến nỗi anh trút cơn giận lên Đức Chúa Trời \q và để những lời như thế thốt ra từ miệng anh?
vi.R: Sao anh lại trút giận lên Đức Chúa Trời \q và để những lời như thế thốt ra từ miệng mình?

ko.L: 그대의 영을 하나님께 돌이켜 대들고 \q 그대 입에서 말들을 내뱉소?
ko.B: 하나님께 분을 품고 \q 그대 입에서 그런 말이 나오게 하오?
ko.R: 어찌하여 하나님께 화를 내며 \q 그런 말을 입 밖에 내오?

decisions.choice: spirit: temper, anger
decisions.reason: Ruach can be wind, breath or spirit. Here it is a person's temper or rage, as in Judges 8:3 and Proverbs 16:32 ("he who rules his spirit"). Eliphaz says Job's anger is now aimed at God himself.

decisions.choice: words: the word millin
decisions.reason: Millin is a poetic word for words, used often in Job. Eliphaz speaks of words that have no place in a reverent mouth; he has called them wind in verse 2.

decisions.choice: anger
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "anger" for the sense of m1, since "turn your spirit" is unclear in English. Literal keeps "spirit".

decisions.choice: such words
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "words"; the context makes plain that Job's angry words are meant.

source.text: מָֽה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְכִֽי־יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: What [is] a mortal that he should be pure, and that he should be righteous, [one] born of a woman?

en.L: What [is] a mortal, that [one] should be pure, \q and that one born of a woman should be righteous?
en.B: How can a mortal be pure? \q How can one born of a woman be righteous?
en.R: Can any human being be pure? \q Can anyone born of a woman be truly righteous?

es.L: ¿Qué [es] el mortal, para que sea puro, \q y para que sea justo el nacido de mujer?
es.B: ¿Cómo puede un mortal ser puro? \q ¿Cómo puede ser justo el nacido de mujer?
es.R: ¿Puede algún ser humano ser puro? \q ¿Puede alguien nacido de mujer ser verdaderamente justo?

fr.L: Qu’[est] le mortel, pour qu’il soit pur, \q et pour que soit juste celui qui est né de la femme ?
fr.B: Comment un mortel pourrait-il être pur ? \q Comment celui qui est né d’une femme serait-il juste ?
fr.R: Un être humain peut-il être pur ? \q Quelqu’un qui est né d’une femme peut-il être vraiment juste ?

sw.L: Mwanadamu [ni] nini, hata awe safi, \q na mzaliwa wa mwanamke hata awe mwenye haki?
sw.B: Mwanadamu awezaje kuwa safi? \q Aliyezaliwa na mwanamke awezaje kuwa mwenye haki?
sw.R: Je, kuna mwanadamu yeyote anayeweza kuwa safi? \q Je, mtu aliyezaliwa na mwanamke anaweza kuwa mwenye haki kweli?

vi.L: Loài người [là] gì mà được tinh sạch, \q và kẻ do người nữ sinh ra là gì mà được công chính?
vi.B: Làm sao loài người có thể tinh sạch? \q Làm sao người do người nữ sinh ra có thể công chính?
vi.R: Có con người nào tinh sạch được không? \q Có ai do người nữ sinh ra mà thật sự công chính không?

ko.L: 사람이 무엇이기에 깨끗하겠으며, \q 여자에게서 난 자가 무엇이기에 의롭겠는가?
ko.B: 사람이 어찌 깨끗할 수 있겠는가? \q 여자에게서 난 자가 어찌 의로울 수 있겠는가?
ko.R: 깨끗할 수 있는 사람이 있겠는가? \q 여자에게서 태어난 사람 중에 정말 의로운 사람이 있겠는가?

decisions.choice: Eliphaz repeats the message of his vision
decisions.reason: In 4:17 Eliphaz reported the words heard in a night vision: "Can a mortal be righteous before God?" He comes back to it here and in verses 15-16, which echo 4:18-19.

decisions.choice: born of a woman: any human being, in his weakness
decisions.reason: Job used the phrase in 14:1 ("a human born of a woman is short of days") and asked who can bring something clean out of something unclean (14:4). Eliphaz takes Job's own words to make his point.

decisions.choice: a mortal: a frail human being
decisions.reason: The word ('enosh) stresses human weakness (4:17; 9:2). It means any person, not a man as opposed to a woman.

decisions.choice: How can ... ? / Can ... ?
decisions.reason: "What is a mortal, that" is a way of asking "how could a mortal ...?". Balanced and Readable ask the question directly and so avoid a pronoun for "a mortal".

source.text: הֵ֣ן בִּ֭קְדֹשָׁיו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא־זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, in his holy [ones] not he trusts, and [the] heavens not are pure in his eyes;

en.L: Look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does not trust in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy ones, \q and [the] heavens are not pure in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes,
en.B: If God does not trust even {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy ones, \q and the heavens are not pure in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sight,
en.R: God does not trust even the heavenly beings around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q In {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes even the heavens are not pure.

es.L: Mira, en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos no confía, \q y [los] cielos no son puros a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos,
es.B: Si Dios no se fía ni de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos, \q y los cielos no son puros ante {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos,
es.R: Dios no confía ni en los seres celestiales que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodean. \q A {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos, ni los cielos son puros.

fr.L: Voici, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne se fie pas à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saints, \q et [les] cieux ne sont pas purs à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux,
fr.B: Si Dieu ne fait pas confiance même à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saints, \q et si les cieux ne sont pas purs à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux,
fr.R: Dieu ne fait même pas confiance aux êtres célestes qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entourent. \q À {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux, même les cieux ne sont pas purs.

sw.L: Tazama, hawaamini watakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na mbingu si safi machoni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}},
sw.B: Ikiwa Mungu hawaamini hata watakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na mbingu si safi machoni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}},
sw.R: Mungu hawaamini hata viumbe wa mbinguni walio karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. \q Machoni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} hata mbingu si safi.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không tin cậy các thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và [các] tầng trời không tinh sạch trong mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Nếu Đức Chúa Trời không tin cậy ngay cả các thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và các tầng trời không tinh sạch trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời không tin cậy ngay cả những đấng ở trên trời quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ngay cả các tầng trời cũng không tinh sạch.

ko.L: 보라, 그분께서는 그분의 거룩한 이들도 믿지 않으시고, \q 하늘도 그분의 눈에 깨끗하지 않은데,
ko.B: 하나님께서 그분의 거룩한 이들조차 믿지 않으시고 \q 하늘도 그분 보시기에 깨끗하지 않다면,
ko.R: 하나님께서는 그분 곁의 하늘의 존재들조차 믿지 않으신다. \q 그분 보시기에는 하늘조차 깨끗하지 않다.

decisions.choice: his holy ones: the heavenly beings around God
decisions.reason: As in 5:1, the holy ones are the beings who serve God in heaven (Psalm 89:6, 8; Zechariah 14:5).

decisions.choice: Eliphaz echoes 4:18
decisions.reason: In his night vision Eliphaz heard that God "puts no trust in his servants and charges his angels with error" (4:18). The thought returns almost word for word.

decisions.choice: look: the first half of a "how much less" argument
decisions.reason: Hen (look) sets up a comparison that verse 16 completes: if this is true of heavenly beings, how much more of a human being. As in Aramaic, the word can also mean "if".

decisions.choice: his holy ones: the reading the scribes marked
decisions.reason: The written consonants of this word and the reading the scribes marked in the margin (ketiv and qere) differ in spelling. The marked reading, followed here, gives the plural "his holy ones", as in 5:1; the written form can be read as a shorter spelling of the same word.

decisions.choice: God (B, R); If (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God, since a pronoun would be unclear at the start of the thought. Balanced writes "if" to show the comparison that verse 16 completes (m3); Readable makes two plain statements.

source.text: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ־שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַמַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: How much less [one who is] abhorrent and corrupt, a man drinking like water injustice!

en.L: how much less [one who is] abhorrent and corrupt, \q {{gender:a person|a man}} who drinks injustice like water!
en.B: how much less one who is vile and corrupt, \q {{gender:a person|a man}} who drinks in wrongdoing like water!
en.R: So how could {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} trust a human being, who is disgusting and rotten \q and gulps down evil as if it were water?

es.L: ¡cuánto menos [el] abominable y corrupto, \q {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} que bebe como agua la injusticia!
es.B: ¡cuánto menos el que es vil y corrupto, \q {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} que se bebe el mal como agua!
es.R: ¿Cómo podría {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} confiar en un ser humano, que es repugnante y está podrido \q y se traga la maldad como si fuera agua?

fr.L: combien moins [celui qui est] abominable et corrompu, \q {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui boit l’injustice comme l’eau !
fr.B: combien moins celui qui est ignoble et corrompu, \q {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui boit le mal comme de l’eau !
fr.R: Alors comment pourrait-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} faire confiance à un être humain, répugnant et pourri, \q qui avale le mal comme si c’était de l’eau ?

sw.L: sembuse [yule aliye] chukizo na mpotovu, \q mtu anywaye uovu kama maji!
sw.B: sembuse yule aliye mwovu na mpotovu, \q mtu anayekunywa maovu kama maji!
sw.R: Basi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} angewezaje kumwamini mwanadamu, aliye chukizo na mwovu \q na anayegugumia uovu kana kwamba ni maji?

vi.L: huống chi [kẻ] đáng ghê tởm và bại hoại, \q là người uống sự bất chính như uống nước!
vi.B: huống chi kẻ đáng ghê tởm và hư hỏng, \q là người uống điều gian ác như uống nước!
vi.R: Vậy làm sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tin cậy được con người, là kẻ đáng ghê tởm và mục nát, \q nốc điều ác như uống nước?

ko.L: 하물며 가증하고 부패한 자, \q 불의를 물처럼 마시는 사람이야 [어떻겠는가]!
ko.B: 하물며 역겹고 썩어 버린 자, \q 악을 물 마시듯 하는 사람이야 말할 것도 없다!
ko.R: 그러니 역겹고 썩은 데다가 \q 악을 물처럼 들이켜는 사람을 그분께서 어찌 믿으시겠는가?

decisions.choice: how much less: from the greater to the lesser
decisions.reason: The words 'af ki finish the argument begun in verse 15: if God does not trust heavenly beings, he will trust a sinful human being even less (compare 4:19).

decisions.choice: corrupt: gone bad, spoiled
decisions.reason: The verb ('alach) is used of people who have "become corrupt" (Psalm 14:3; 53:4). The picture is of something that has gone sour or rotten.

decisions.choice: drinks injustice like water: does wrong freely and all the time
decisions.reason: A person who drinks water does it often and without a second thought. Elihu will use the same picture of Job: he "drinks scorn like water" (34:7).

decisions.choice: a man: a person, any human being
decisions.reason: The word ('ish) here stands for a human being as such, set against the heavenly beings of verse 15.

decisions.choice: inclusive wording, with "a man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word means any human being (m4), so the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default.

decisions.choice: So how could he trust
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the comparison with verse 15 (m1).

source.text: אֲחַוְךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י וְזֶֽה־חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃

records.literal_gloss: I will tell you; listen to me; and this [which] I have seen, and I will recount,

en.L: I will tell you; listen to me, \q and what I have seen I will recount,
en.B: Listen to me, and I will explain; \q I will tell you what I have seen,
en.R: Listen to me, and I will explain. \q I will tell you what I have seen,

es.L: Yo te informaré; escúchame, \q y lo que he visto contaré,
es.B: Escúchame, y te lo explicaré; \q te contaré lo que he visto,
es.R: Escúchame, y te lo explicaré. \q Te contaré lo que he visto,

fr.L: Je t’instruirai ; écoute-moi, \q et ce que j’ai vu, je le raconterai,
fr.B: Écoute-moi, je vais t’expliquer ; \q je te dirai ce que j’ai vu,
fr.R: Écoute-moi, je vais t’expliquer. \q Je vais te dire ce que j’ai vu,

sw.L: Nitakueleza; nisikilize, \q na kile nilichokiona nitakisimulia,
sw.B: Nisikilize, nami nitakueleza; \q nitakuambia yale niliyoyaona,
sw.R: Nisikilize, nami nitakueleza. \q Nitakuambia yale niliyoyaona,

vi.L: Tôi sẽ chỉ cho anh; hãy nghe tôi, \q và điều tôi đã thấy, tôi sẽ thuật lại,
vi.B: Hãy nghe tôi, tôi sẽ giải thích cho anh; \q tôi sẽ kể cho anh những gì tôi đã thấy,
vi.R: Hãy nghe tôi, tôi sẽ giải thích cho anh. \q Tôi sẽ kể cho anh những gì tôi đã thấy,

ko.L: 내가 그대에게 일러 줄 테니 내 말을 들으시오. \q 내가 본 것을 말하겠는데,
ko.B: 내 말을 들으시오. 내가 설명해 주겠소. \q 내가 본 것을 그대에게 말해 주겠는데,
ko.R: 내 말을 들어 보시오. 내가 설명해 주겠소. \q 내가 본 것을 말해 주겠는데,

decisions.choice: what I have seen: what I have observed in life
alternatives: what I saw in a vision
decisions.reason: The verb (chazah) is often used of seeing visions, and Eliphaz has spoken of a vision (4:12-16). Here, followed by what the wise have handed down (verse 18), it most likely means what he has observed, as in 4:8 ("as I have seen").

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into verses 18-19
decisions.reason: What Eliphaz will tell is also what the wise have taught (verses 18-19). Every level ends verse 17 with a comma.

decisions.choice: Listen to me, and I will explain
alternatives: I will tell you; listen to me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the call to listen first, which is the natural order in English.

source.text: אֲשֶׁר־חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְלֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Which wise [men] have told, and not have hidden, from their fathers,

en.L: what [the] wise have told, \q and have not hidden, from their fathers,
en.B: what the wise have declared \q and have not hidden, what came from their ancestors,
en.R: what wise people have taught, \q passing on all they learned from their ancestors.

es.L: lo que [los] sabios han declarado, \q y no han ocultado, de sus padres,
es.B: lo que los sabios han anunciado \q sin ocultarlo, lo que vino de sus antepasados,
es.R: lo que la gente sabia ha enseñado, \q transmitiendo todo lo que aprendió de sus antepasados.

fr.L: ce que [les] sages ont déclaré, \q et n’ont pas caché, [venant] de leurs pères,
fr.B: ce que les sages ont annoncé \q sans rien cacher, ce qui venait de leurs ancêtres,
fr.R: ce que les sages ont enseigné, \q en transmettant tout ce qu’ils avaient appris de leurs ancêtres.

sw.L: yale ambayo wenye hekima wameyasema, \q wala hawakuyaficha, kutoka kwa baba zao,
sw.B: yale ambayo wenye hekima wameyatangaza \q bila kuyaficha, yaliyotoka kwa mababu zao,
sw.R: yale ambayo watu wenye hekima wamefundisha, \q wakipitisha yote waliyojifunza kutoka kwa mababu zao.

vi.L: điều mà [những] người khôn ngoan đã công bố, \q và không giấu, [nhận] từ tổ phụ họ,
vi.B: điều mà những người khôn ngoan đã truyền lại \q chẳng giấu giếm, là điều họ nhận từ tổ tiên,
vi.R: điều mà những người khôn ngoan đã dạy, \q truyền lại mọi điều họ học được từ tổ tiên.

ko.L: 그것은 지혜로운 자들이 전하여 주고 \q 그들의 조상들에게서 [받아] 숨기지 않은 것이니,
ko.B: 지혜로운 이들이 밝혀 주고 \q 감추지 않은 것, 그들의 조상에게서 내려온 것이다.
ko.R: 지혜로운 사람들이 가르쳐 온 것이다. \q 그들은 조상에게서 배운 것을 모두 전해 주었다.

decisions.choice: from their fathers: the teaching came down from earlier generations
alternatives: they did not hide it from their fathers
decisions.reason: The words most likely go with the whole verse: the wise passed on, without holding anything back, what they had received from their ancestors. Bildad made the same appeal to the wisdom of past generations (8:8-10).

decisions.choice: the wise: teachers who kept and handed down the tradition
decisions.reason: In Israel and among its neighbors, wisdom was taught by older teachers to younger, and its sayings were passed from one generation to the next (Proverbs 4:1-4).

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The fathers here are the generations before, men and women alike, so Balanced and Readable say "ancestors".

source.text: לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: To them, to them alone was given the land, and not passed a stranger in their midst.

en.L: to them alone the land was given, \q and no stranger passed through their midst.
en.B: to whom alone the land was given, \q when no foreigner moved among them.
en.R: The land was given to them alone, \q and no foreigners lived among them.

es.L: a ellos solos fue dada la tierra, \q y ningún extraño pasó en medio de ellos.
es.B: a quienes solamente se les dio la tierra, \q cuando ningún extranjero andaba entre ellos.
es.R: La tierra se les dio solo a ellos, \q y ningún extranjero vivía entre ellos.

fr.L: à eux seuls le pays a été donné, \q et aucun étranger n’est passé au milieu d’eux.
fr.B: eux à qui seuls le pays avait été donné, \q quand aucun étranger ne circulait parmi eux.
fr.R: Le pays avait été donné à eux seuls, \q et aucun étranger ne vivait parmi eux.

sw.L: wao peke yao walipewa nchi, \q wala mgeni hakupita katikati yao.
sw.B: ambao wao peke yao walipewa nchi, \q wakati ambapo hakuna mgeni aliyetembea kati yao.
sw.R: Nchi ilitolewa kwao peke yao, \q wala hakuna wageni walioishi kati yao.

vi.L: chỉ cho riêng họ đất được ban cho, \q và không kẻ lạ nào đi qua giữa họ.
vi.B: là những người duy nhất được ban cho đất này, \q khi chưa có người ngoại bang nào đi lại giữa họ.
vi.R: Đất này được ban cho riêng họ, \q và không có người nước ngoài nào sống giữa họ.

ko.L: 그들에게만 그 땅이 주어졌고, \q 낯선 자가 그들 가운데 지나가지 않았다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 땅을 홀로 받은 사람들이었고, \q 그때에는 이방인이 그들 사이에 오가지 않았다.
ko.R: 그 땅은 그들에게만 주어졌고, \q 그들 가운데에는 외국인이 살지 않았다.

decisions.choice: the land given to them alone: a pure tradition, before outsiders came
decisions.reason: Eliphaz claims his teaching comes from ancestors who held their land alone, before foreigners mixed with them. Their wisdom, he implies, is pure and untouched by strange ideas.

decisions.choice: a stranger: an outsider, a foreigner
decisions.reason: Zar is someone who does not belong, an outsider (Proverbs 5:10, 17). It may also suggest a foreign raider, but the point is that no outsider came among them.

decisions.choice: foreigner
decisions.reason: In modern English a "stranger" is anyone we do not know; "foreigner" says that the person was from another people (m2).

source.text: כָּל־יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] days of [the] wicked he [is] writhing, and [the] number of years are stored up for the ruthless.

en.L: All [the] days of [the] wicked, he is writhing in pain, \q and [the] number of years is stored up for the ruthless.
en.B: The wicked person writhes in pain all his days, \q through all the years laid up for the ruthless.
en.R: A wicked person is in agony all his life; \q a cruel person has only a few years stored up.

es.L: Todos [los] días del malvado, él se retuerce de dolor, \q y [el] número de años está guardado para el violento.
es.B: El malvado se retuerce de dolor todos sus días, \q durante todos los años reservados para el tirano.
es.R: El malvado vive angustiado toda su vida; \q el que es cruel solo tiene unos pocos años guardados.

fr.L: Tous [les] jours du méchant, il se tord de douleur, \q et [le] nombre des années est réservé au tyran.
fr.B: Le méchant se tord de douleur tous ses jours, \q pendant toutes les années réservées au tyran.
fr.R: Le méchant vit dans l’angoisse toute sa vie ; \q le cruel n’a que quelques années devant lui.

sw.L: Siku zote za mwovu, yeye anagaagaa kwa maumivu, \q na hesabu ya miaka imewekwa akiba kwa ajili ya mdhalimu.
sw.B: Mwovu hugaagaa kwa maumivu siku zake zote, \q katika miaka yote aliyowekewa mdhalimu.
sw.R: Mtu mwovu yuko katika mateso maisha yake yote; \q mtu katili amewekewa miaka michache tu.

vi.L: Mọi ngày của kẻ ác, hắn quằn quại đau đớn, \q và số năm được dành sẵn cho kẻ bạo ngược.
vi.B: Kẻ ác quằn quại trong đau đớn suốt đời mình, \q trong mọi năm tháng dành cho kẻ bạo ngược.
vi.R: Kẻ ác sống trong khổ sở suốt đời; \q kẻ tàn ác chỉ có ít năm dành cho mình.

ko.L: 악인은 그 모든 날 동안 몸부림치며 괴로워하고, \q 포악한 자에게는 햇수가 정해져 쌓여 있다.
ko.B: 악한 자는 평생 고통에 몸부림치고, \q 포악한 자에게 정해진 모든 해 동안 그러하다.
ko.R: 악한 사람은 평생 괴로움 속에 살고, \q 잔인한 사람에게는 남은 해가 얼마 없다.

decisions.choice: writhing: twisting in pain, as in labor
decisions.reason: The verb (chul, in a reflexive form) is used of a woman in labor and of anguish and terror. Eliphaz begins his portrait of the wicked (verses 20-35): whatever he seems to have, he lives in torment.

decisions.choice: the number of years stored up: his life span is fixed and limited
alternatives: the number of years is hidden from the ruthless
decisions.reason: The verb (tsafan) means to store up or to hide. Most likely the ruthless has only a set number of years laid up for him. Some read that the number of his years is hidden from him, so that he lives in fear of his end.

decisions.choice: the ruthless: the violent oppressor
decisions.reason: The word ('arits) is a tyrant, one who uses force without pity (6:23; Psalm 37:35).

decisions.choice: the wicked person ... he/his
decisions.reason: From here to verse 35 Eliphaz paints a portrait of one typical wicked person, in the masculine singular. English keeps "he" through the portrait so that the reader can follow the one figure; the type stands for anyone who lives this way.

decisions.choice: only a few years
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of m2: his years are counted and few.

source.text: קוֹל־פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאָזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sound of terrors [is] in his ears; in peace [the] destroyer will come [upon] him.

en.L: [The] sound of terrors [is] in his ears; \q in peace a destroyer will come upon him.
en.B: Sounds of terror fill his ears; \q when all is well, a destroyer attacks him.
en.R: He keeps hearing frightening sounds. \q Just when he feels safe, a raider attacks him.

es.L: [El] sonido de terrores [está] en sus oídos; \q en paz vendrá sobre él un destructor.
es.B: Sonidos de terror llenan sus oídos; \q cuando todo va bien, un saqueador lo ataca.
es.R: Siempre está oyendo ruidos que lo asustan. \q Justo cuando se siente seguro, un bandido lo ataca.

fr.L: [Le] bruit des terreurs [est] à ses oreilles ; \q dans la paix un dévastateur viendra sur lui.
fr.B: Des bruits terrifiants remplissent ses oreilles ; \q quand tout va bien, un pillard l’attaque.
fr.R: Il entend sans cesse des bruits effrayants. \q Juste au moment où il se sent en sécurité, un pillard l’attaque.

sw.L: Sauti ya vitisho [iko] masikioni mwake; \q katika amani mharibifu atamjia.
sw.B: Sauti za vitisho zinajaa masikioni mwake; \q wakati mambo yote ni shwari, mporaji anamshambulia.
sw.R: Anasikia sauti za kutisha kila wakati. \q Wakati tu anapojiona yuko salama, mnyang'anyi anamvamia.

vi.L: Tiếng của những điều kinh hãi [ở] trong tai hắn; \q trong lúc bình an, kẻ hủy diệt sẽ đến trên hắn.
vi.B: Tiếng kinh hoàng vang đầy tai hắn; \q giữa lúc yên ổn, kẻ cướp phá ập đến.
vi.R: Hắn luôn nghe những âm thanh đáng sợ. \q Ngay khi hắn thấy mình an toàn, kẻ cướp liền tấn công hắn.

ko.L: 두려운 소리가 그의 귀에 [있고], \q 평안할 때에 약탈자가 그에게 닥친다.
ko.B: 무서운 소리가 그의 귀에 가득하고, \q 모든 것이 평안할 때 약탈자가 그를 덮친다.
ko.R: 그의 귀에는 늘 무서운 소리가 들린다. \q 안전하다고 느끼는 바로 그때 약탈자가 그를 덮친다.

decisions.choice: in peace: in a time of ease and safety
decisions.reason: Shalom here is a time of quiet and well-being. Just when the wicked person feels safe, disaster strikes, as Job himself experienced (1:13-19; 3:25-26).

decisions.choice: a destroyer: a raider who plunders and ruins
decisions.reason: The word (shoded) is used of raiders and plunderers (Jeremiah 6:26; 48:8). The sound of terrors in his ears may be his own fears, but the raider is real.

decisions.choice: terrors: fearful sounds, dread
decisions.reason: The word (pachad) is fear and the things that cause it. Job said, "what I feared has come upon me" (3:25); Eliphaz describes the life of the wicked in the same terms.

decisions.choice: when all is well
decisions.reason: "In peace" could suggest a calm heart; Balanced says that the time itself seems safe (m1).

source.text: לֹא־יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְצָפ֖וּי ה֣וּא אֱלֵי־חָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: Not he believes [he will] return from darkness, and [is] watched for he by [the] sword.

en.L: He does not believe [he will] return from darkness, \q and he is marked out for [the] sword.
en.B: He does not expect to escape from darkness; \q he is marked out for the sword.
en.R: He has no hope of getting out of the darkness. \q He knows a sword is waiting for him.

es.L: No cree que [vaya a] volver de las tinieblas, \q y está señalado para [la] espada.
es.B: No espera escapar de las tinieblas; \q está señalado para la espada.
es.R: No tiene esperanza de salir de la oscuridad. \q Sabe que una espada lo está esperando.

fr.L: Il ne croit pas [pouvoir] revenir des ténèbres, \q et il est guetté par [l’]épée.
fr.B: Il n’espère pas échapper aux ténèbres ; \q il est désigné pour l’épée.
fr.R: Il n’a aucun espoir de sortir de l’obscurité. \q Il sait qu’une épée l’attend.

sw.L: Haamini kwamba [atarudi] kutoka gizani, \q naye amewekewa upanga.
sw.B: Hatarajii kuepuka giza; \q amewekwa kwa ajili ya upanga.
sw.R: Hana tumaini la kutoka gizani. \q Anajua kwamba upanga unamngoja.

vi.L: Hắn không tin [mình sẽ] trở về khỏi bóng tối, \q và hắn bị gươm rình chờ.
vi.B: Hắn không mong thoát khỏi bóng tối; \q hắn đã bị gươm nhắm sẵn.
vi.R: Hắn chẳng còn hy vọng ra khỏi bóng tối. \q Hắn biết có lưỡi gươm đang chờ mình.

ko.L: 그는 어둠에서 돌아오리라고 믿지 못하고, \q 칼이 그를 노리고 있다.
ko.B: 그는 어둠에서 벗어나리라 기대하지 못하고, \q 칼에 죽을 자로 정해져 있다.
ko.R: 그는 어둠에서 빠져나올 희망이 없다. \q 칼이 자기를 기다리고 있음을 알고 있다.

decisions.choice: return from darkness: escape disaster and death
decisions.reason: Darkness is ruin and death (verses 23, 30; 10:21-22). The wicked person has no hope that his troubles will end.

decisions.choice: marked out: watched for, set aside for
decisions.reason: The verb (tsafah) means to watch or look out. Watched for by the sword, he is like someone an enemy has picked out to kill.

decisions.choice: marked out: the reading the scribes marked
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the reading the scribes marked in the margin (qere) give two forms of the same verb. The sense is the same: he is singled out for the sword.

decisions.choice: a sword is waiting for him
alternatives: he is marked out for the sword
decisions.reason: Readable turns the passive into an active sentence, which is easier to follow.

source.text: נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע׀כִּֽי־נָכ֖וֹן בְּיָד֣וֹ יֽוֹם־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: [Is] wandering he for bread: where? He knows that ready in his hand [is the] day of darkness.

en.L: He wanders for bread: 'Where [is it]?' \q He knows that a day of darkness is ready at his hand.
en.B: He wanders about for food, saying, 'Where is it?' \q He knows that the day of darkness is close at hand.
en.R: He wanders around looking for food, asking, 'Where can I find some?' \q He knows that his day of disaster is near.

es.L: Anda errante por pan: “¿Dónde [está]?” \q Sabe que un día de tinieblas está dispuesto a su mano.
es.B: Vaga en busca de comida, diciendo: “¿Dónde la hay?” \q Sabe que el día de tinieblas está cerca.
es.R: Anda de un lado a otro buscando comida y pregunta: “¿Dónde puedo encontrar algo?” \q Sabe que su día de desgracia está cerca.

fr.L: Il erre pour du pain : “Où [est-il] ?” \q Il sait qu’un jour de ténèbres est prêt à sa portée.
fr.B: Il erre à la recherche de nourriture, en disant : “Où en trouver ?” \q Il sait que le jour des ténèbres est tout proche.
fr.R: Il erre à la recherche de nourriture et demande : “Où vais-je en trouver ?” \q Il sait que son jour de malheur est proche.

sw.L: Anatangatanga kwa ajili ya chakula: 'Kiko wapi?' \q Anajua kwamba siku ya giza iko tayari mkononi mwake.
sw.B: Anazunguka akitafuta chakula, akisema, 'Kiko wapi?' \q Anajua kwamba siku ya giza iko karibu.
sw.R: Anazunguka akitafuta chakula na kuuliza, 'Nitakipata wapi?' \q Anajua kwamba siku yake ya maafa iko karibu.

vi.L: Hắn lang thang vì bánh: 'Ở đâu?' \q Hắn biết ngày tối tăm đã sẵn sàng bên tay hắn.
vi.B: Hắn đi lang thang kiếm thức ăn và hỏi: 'Ở đâu có?' \q Hắn biết ngày tối tăm đã kề bên.
vi.R: Hắn đi lang thang tìm thức ăn và hỏi: 'Tôi có thể tìm thấy ở đâu?' \q Hắn biết ngày tai họa của hắn đã gần.

ko.L: 그는 빵을 찾아 떠돌며 '어디 [있느냐]?' 하니, \q 어둠의 날이 그의 손에 예비된 줄을 안다.
ko.B: 그는 먹을 것을 찾아 '어디 있느냐?' 하며 헤매고, \q 어둠의 날이 가까이 왔음을 안다.
ko.R: 그는 '먹을 것을 어디서 찾을까?' 하며 떠돌아다닌다. \q 자기에게 재앙의 날이 다가왔음을 안다.

decisions.choice: Where?: he cannot find food
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "Where?": the wicked person roams hungry, asking where food is. The ancient Greek translation reads a word with the same consonants that means a kite or vulture: "he is given as food for vultures".

decisions.choice: ready at his hand: close by, about to come
decisions.reason: What is ready at someone's hand is near and certain. The day of darkness, the day of his ruin, is close (compare 18:12).

decisions.choice: the day of darkness: the day of ruin and death
decisions.reason: Darkness, as in verse 22, stands for disaster and death.

decisions.choice: saying (B); asking (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add a speech verb so the question reads as his words.

source.text: יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ׀עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Terrify him distress and anguish; it overpowers him like a king ready for [the] attack.

en.L: Distress and anguish terrify him; \q they overpower him like a king ready for [the] attack.
en.B: Distress and anguish fill him with terror; \q they overpower him like a king ready for battle.
en.R: Trouble and suffering frighten him. \q They overwhelm him like a king attacking with his army.

es.L: La angustia y la aflicción lo aterran; \q lo dominan como un rey dispuesto para [el] asalto.
es.B: La angustia y la aflicción lo llenan de terror; \q lo dominan como un rey preparado para la batalla.
es.R: Los problemas y el sufrimiento lo asustan. \q Lo arrollan como un rey que ataca con su ejército.

fr.L: La détresse et l’angoisse le terrifient ; \q elles l’accablent comme un roi prêt pour [l’]assaut.
fr.B: La détresse et l’angoisse le remplissent de terreur ; \q elles l’écrasent comme un roi prêt pour la bataille.
fr.R: Les difficultés et la souffrance lui font peur. \q Elles l’écrasent comme un roi qui attaque avec son armée.

sw.L: Dhiki na uchungu humtisha; \q humshinda kama mfalme aliye tayari kwa shambulio.
sw.B: Dhiki na uchungu humjaza hofu; \q humlemea kama mfalme aliye tayari kwa vita.
sw.R: Taabu na mateso humtia hofu. \q Humlemea kama mfalme anayeshambulia pamoja na jeshi lake.

vi.L: Gian truân và khốn quẫn làm hắn kinh hãi; \q chúng áp đảo hắn như một vua sẵn sàng cho [cuộc] tấn công.
vi.B: Gian truân và khốn quẫn khiến hắn khiếp sợ; \q chúng đè bẹp hắn như một vua sẵn sàng ra trận.
vi.R: Khó khăn và đau khổ làm hắn sợ hãi. \q Chúng tràn ngập hắn như một vua dẫn quân tấn công.

ko.L: 고난과 고통이 그를 두렵게 하고, \q 공격할 준비가 된 왕처럼 그를 덮친다.
ko.B: 환난과 고통이 그를 두려움에 떨게 하고, \q 전쟁 준비를 갖춘 왕처럼 그를 짓누른다.
ko.R: 괴로움과 고통이 그를 겁에 질리게 한다. \q 군대를 이끌고 쳐들어오는 왕처럼 그를 덮친다.

decisions.choice: attack: battle, the charge
decisions.reason: The word (kidor) is found only here in the Bible. From the context and a related word meaning to run or circle, it is most likely the onset of battle.

decisions.choice: they overpower him: distress and anguish together
decisions.reason: The verb is singular ("it overpowers him"), taking distress and anguish as one force, like an army led by its king.

decisions.choice: they overpower
decisions.reason: English needs a plural verb after two subjects; Literal says "they" (m2).

decisions.choice: attacking with his army
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture plain: the troubles come on him like a king's army.

source.text: כִּֽי־נָטָ֣ה אֶל־אֵ֣ל יָד֑וֹ וְאֶל־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: For he has stretched out against God his hand, and against [the] Almighty he plays the strong man.

en.L: For he has stretched out his hand against God, \q and against [the] Almighty he behaves arrogantly;
en.B: For he has stretched out his hand against God \q and set himself up against the Almighty;
en.R: This is because he raised his fist against God \q and tried to fight God All-Powerful.

es.L: Porque ha extendido su mano contra Dios, \q y contra [el] Todopoderoso se porta con arrogancia;
es.B: Porque ha extendido su mano contra Dios \q y se ha alzado contra el Todopoderoso;
es.R: Esto es porque levantó el puño contra Dios \q y trató de pelear contra el Dios Todopoderoso.

fr.L: Car il a étendu sa main contre Dieu, \q et contre [le] Tout-Puissant il fait le fier ;
fr.B: Car il a levé la main contre Dieu \q et s’est dressé contre le Tout-Puissant ;
fr.R: C’est parce qu’il a levé le poing contre Dieu \q et qu’il a voulu combattre Dieu le Tout-Puissant.

sw.L: Kwa maana amenyoosha mkono wake dhidi ya Mungu, \q na dhidi ya Mwenyezi anajitapa;
sw.B: Kwa maana amenyoosha mkono wake dhidi ya Mungu \q na kujiinua dhidi ya Mwenyezi;
sw.R: Hii ni kwa sababu alimwinulia Mungu ngumi \q na kujaribu kupigana na Mungu Mwenyezi.

vi.L: Vì hắn đã giơ tay chống lại Đức Chúa Trời, \q và chống lại Đấng Toàn Năng hắn tỏ ra kiêu căng;
vi.B: Vì hắn đã giơ tay chống lại Đức Chúa Trời \q và nổi lên chống đối Đấng Toàn Năng;
vi.R: Đó là vì hắn đã giơ nắm đấm lên chống lại Đức Chúa Trời \q và tìm cách đánh nhau với Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng.

ko.L: 이는 그가 하나님께 손을 뻗어 대적하고 \q 전능자께 교만하게 굴며,
ko.B: 그가 하나님을 향해 손을 뻗치고 \q 전능자께 맞서 힘을 과시하며,
ko.R: 그가 하나님께 주먹을 휘두르고 \q 전능하신 하나님과 싸우려 했기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: for: the reason for his suffering
decisions.reason: Verses 25-28 give the reason for the terrors of verses 20-24: the wicked person has made war on God.

decisions.choice: stretched out his hand against: attacked
decisions.reason: To stretch out the hand against someone is to strike at him (1:11-12; 2:5). Here a mere human attacks God himself.

decisions.choice: behaves arrogantly: plays the hero
decisions.reason: The verb (gavar, reflexive) means to act as a strong man or a warrior (Isaiah 42:13). The wicked person sets himself up as God's equal in battle.

decisions.choice: the Almighty: Shaddai
decisions.reason: Shaddai is an old name for God, used often in Job, rendered "the Almighty".

decisions.choice: God All-Powerful
decisions.reason: Readable uses the book-wide wording for Shaddai.

decisions.choice: raised his fist
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the idiom (m2): a threat of violence.

source.text: יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣יו בְּצַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: He runs against him with [a] neck, with [the] thickness of [the] bosses of his shields.

en.L: he runs against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with [a stiff] neck, \q with [the] thick bosses of his shields.
en.B: he charges at {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} defiantly, \q with his thick, studded shield.
en.R: He charges at God with his head down, \q behind his thick, heavy shield.

es.L: corre contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con [la] cerviz [erguida], \q con [los] gruesos bollones de sus escudos.
es.B: arremete contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con desafío, \q con su escudo grueso y tachonado.
es.R: Embiste contra Dios con la cabeza agachada, \q detrás de su escudo grueso y pesado.

fr.L: il court contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, la nuque [raide], \q avec [les] bosses épaisses de ses boucliers.
fr.B: il fonce sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec défi, \q avec son bouclier épais et clouté.
fr.R: Il fonce sur Dieu, tête baissée, \q derrière son bouclier épais et lourd.

sw.L: anamkimbilia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kwa shingo [ngumu], \q kwa vifundo vinene vya ngao zake.
sw.B: anamshambulia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kwa ukaidi, \q akiwa na ngao yake nene yenye vifundo.
sw.R: Anamvamia Mungu akiwa ameinamisha kichwa, \q nyuma ya ngao yake nene na nzito.

vi.L: hắn xông vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với cổ [cứng], \q với những núm dày của các khiên hắn.
vi.B: hắn ngạo nghễ lao vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q với cái khiên dày đóng đinh tán.
vi.R: Hắn cúi đầu lao vào Đức Chúa Trời \q sau cái khiên dày và nặng của hắn.

ko.L: [뻣뻣한] 목을 세우고 그분께 달려들며, \q 두꺼운 방패 돌기를 앞세웠기 때문이다.
ko.B: 고집스럽게 그분께 돌진하고, \q 두껍고 징 박힌 방패를 들이댔기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그는 머리를 숙이고 하나님께 달려든다. \q 두껍고 무거운 방패 뒤에 숨어서 말이다.

decisions.choice: with neck: with stiff-necked defiance, head down for the charge
decisions.reason: The neck is a picture of pride and stubbornness (Psalm 75:6; Isaiah 48:4). The warrior charges with his head lowered and his neck stiff. Some take it the other way round, that God runs at the wicked person's neck, but verse 25 makes the wicked the attacker.

decisions.choice: the bosses of his shields: the thick metal knobs on a shield
decisions.reason: A shield often had a raised boss in the middle to turn blows aside. The plural "shields" may picture a whole row of shields or simply one heavy shield.

decisions.choice: him: God
decisions.reason: The pronoun points back to God in verse 25: the wicked person charges at God.

decisions.choice: defiantly (B); with his head down (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m1).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God for clarity (m3).

decisions.choice: the "because" of verse 25 is completed in verse 26 ("때문이다")
decisions.reason: Korean puts the reason ending on the last verb, so verse 25 runs on with "-며" and verse 26 closes the reason; each verse still keeps its own content.

source.text: כִּֽי־כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּחֶלְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי־כָֽסֶל׃

records.literal_gloss: For he has covered his face with his fat, and he has made fat upon [the] loins,

en.L: for he has covered his face with his fat \q and made fat upon [his] loins,
en.B: for he has covered his face with fat \q and piled up fat on his waist,
en.R: He has grown fat and pleased with himself, \q with fat on his face and around his waist.

es.L: porque ha cubierto su rostro con su grasa \q y ha echado grasa sobre [sus] lomos,
es.B: porque se ha cubierto la cara de grasa \q y ha acumulado grasa en la cintura,
es.R: Se ha puesto gordo y satisfecho de sí mismo, \q con grasa en la cara y alrededor de la cintura.

fr.L: car il a couvert son visage de sa graisse \q et fait de la graisse sur [ses] reins,
fr.B: car il s’est couvert le visage de graisse \q et a accumulé de la graisse sur ses hanches,
fr.R: Il est devenu gras et content de lui, \q avec de la graisse sur le visage et autour de la taille.

sw.L: kwa maana amefunika uso wake kwa mafuta yake \q na kufanya mafuta juu ya viuno [vyake],
sw.B: kwa maana amejifunika uso kwa unene \q na kurundika mafuta kiunoni,
sw.R: Amenenepa na kujiridhisha mwenyewe, \q akiwa na mafuta usoni na kiunoni.

vi.L: vì hắn đã lấy mỡ mình che mặt \q và làm mỡ dày trên hông [hắn],
vi.B: vì mặt hắn phủ đầy mỡ \q và hông hắn chất đầy mỡ,
vi.R: Hắn đã trở nên béo tốt và tự mãn, \q mặt đầy mỡ và bụng phệ ra.

ko.L: 그가 자기 기름으로 얼굴을 덮고 \q [자기] 허리에 비계를 붙였으며,
ko.B: 그는 얼굴이 기름기로 덮이고 \q 허리에 살이 두둑이 쪘으며,
ko.R: 그는 살찌고 스스로 만족하여, \q 얼굴과 허리에 기름기가 가득하다.

decisions.choice: fat: prosperity that makes a person proud and careless of God
decisions.reason: Fatness is a picture of wealth and of the self-satisfaction it breeds: "Jeshurun grew fat and kicked ... he forsook God" (Deuteronomy 32:15; compare Psalm 73:7; 119:70). Eliphaz explains why the wicked person dares to fight God.

decisions.choice: fat: the rare word pimah
decisions.reason: This word is found only here in the Bible; the parallel line and later Hebrew show that it means fat.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into verse 28
decisions.reason: Verses 27-28 go together: he grew fat, and he settled in ruined cities. Literal and Balanced end verse 27 with a comma.

decisions.choice: pleased with himself
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1), then keeps the picture of the fat face and waist.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן׀עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָד֗וֹת בָּ֭תִּים לֹא־יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he dwelt [in] cities destroyed, houses [that] not they will dwell in them, which are destined for heaps.

en.L: and he has lived in destroyed cities, \q in houses [that] no one should live in, \q which are destined to become heaps.
en.B: and he has lived in ruined cities, \q in houses no one should live in, \q houses marked out to become heaps of rubble.
en.R: He has made his home in ruined towns, in houses no one should live in, \q houses that are about to fall into piles of rubble.

es.L: y ha habitado en ciudades destruidas, \q en casas [que] nadie debería habitar, \q que están destinadas a ser montones.
es.B: y ha vivido en ciudades en ruinas, \q en casas que nadie debería habitar, \q casas destinadas a ser montones de escombros.
es.R: Se ha instalado en pueblos en ruinas, en casas donde nadie debería vivir, \q casas que están a punto de convertirse en montones de escombros.

fr.L: et il a habité des villes détruites, \q des maisons [où] l’on ne devrait pas habiter, \q qui sont destinées à devenir des monceaux.
fr.B: et il a vécu dans des villes en ruine, \q dans des maisons où personne ne devrait vivre, \q des maisons vouées à n’être que des tas de décombres.
fr.R: Il s’est installé dans des villes en ruine, dans des maisons où personne ne devrait vivre, \q des maisons qui vont bientôt s’effondrer en tas de décombres.

sw.L: naye amekaa katika miji iliyoharibiwa, \q katika nyumba [ambazo] hakuna mtu angefaa kukaa ndani yake, \q zilizokusudiwa kuwa magofu.
sw.B: naye ameishi katika miji iliyobomoka, \q katika nyumba ambazo hakuna anayepaswa kuishi ndani yake, \q nyumba zilizowekwa kuwa marundo ya kifusi.
sw.R: Amejenga makao yake katika miji iliyobomoka, katika nyumba ambazo hakuna anayepaswa kuishi, \q nyumba zilizo karibu kuanguka na kuwa marundo ya kifusi.

vi.L: và hắn đã ở trong những thành bị tàn phá, \q trong những nhà [mà] không ai nên ở, \q là những nhà sẽ thành đống đổ nát.
vi.B: và hắn đã sống trong những thành điêu tàn, \q trong những căn nhà không ai nên ở, \q những căn nhà đã định phải thành đống gạch vụn.
vi.R: Hắn đã đến ở trong những thị trấn đổ nát, trong những ngôi nhà chẳng ai nên ở, \q những ngôi nhà sắp sụp thành đống gạch vụn.

ko.L: 황폐한 성읍들, \q 아무도 살지 않을 집들, \q 돌무더기가 될 집들에 살았다.
ko.B: 폐허가 된 성읍들, \q 아무도 살아서는 안 될 집들, \q 돌무더기가 되기로 정해진 집들에 자리 잡았다.
ko.R: 그는 무너진 마을, 아무도 살아서는 안 될 집에 자리를 잡았다. \q 그 집들은 곧 무너져 돌무더기가 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: he has lived in ruined cities: his defiance, not yet his punishment
alternatives: he will end up living in ruins
decisions.reason: The verb form continues verse 27, so this most likely describes what the wicked person has done: he settled in cities that had been destroyed, perhaps under a curse (compare Joshua 6:26), defying God. Many read it as his punishment instead: he will be left to live among ruins. Verse 29 turns to what will happen to him.

decisions.choice: that no one should live in: abandoned, not fit to live in
decisions.reason: The words say that people would not live in such houses, either because they lie in ruins or because they are under a curse.

decisions.choice: destined to become heaps: doomed to be rubble
decisions.reason: Gallim are heaps of stones; a city made a heap is utterly destroyed (Jeremiah 9:10; 51:37).

decisions.choice: two lines
decisions.reason: Readable joins the first two lines, since it states the place once.

source.text: לֹֽא־יֶ֭עְשַׁר וְלֹא־יָק֣וּם חֵיל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not he will be rich and not will endure his wealth, and not will stretch to the earth their possession.

en.L: He will not become rich, and his wealth will not endure, \q and their possessions will not stretch out on the land.
en.B: He will not stay rich, his wealth will not last, \q and his possessions will not spread across the land.
en.R: He will not stay rich, and his wealth will not last. \q His property will not spread out over the land.

es.L: No se enriquecerá, ni perdurará su riqueza, \q ni se extenderán sus posesiones por la tierra.
es.B: No seguirá siendo rico, su riqueza no durará, \q y sus bienes no se extenderán por el país.
es.R: No seguirá siendo rico, y su riqueza no durará. \q Sus propiedades no se extenderán por la tierra.

fr.L: Il ne s’enrichira pas, et sa richesse ne tiendra pas, \q et leurs possessions ne s’étendront pas sur la terre.
fr.B: Il ne restera pas riche, sa fortune ne durera pas, \q et ses biens ne s’étendront pas sur le pays.
fr.R: Il ne restera pas riche, et sa fortune ne durera pas. \q Ses propriétés ne s’étendront pas sur le pays.

sw.L: Hatatajirika, wala mali yake haitadumu, \q wala milki zao hazitaenea juu ya nchi.
sw.B: Hatabaki tajiri, mali yake haitadumu, \q wala milki zake hazitaenea katika nchi.
sw.R: Hatabaki tajiri, na mali yake haitadumu. \q Mashamba yake hayatapanuka katika nchi.

vi.L: Hắn sẽ không giàu có, của cải hắn sẽ không bền, \q và tài sản của chúng sẽ không trải rộng trên đất.
vi.B: Hắn sẽ không giàu mãi, của cải hắn sẽ không bền lâu, \q tài sản hắn cũng chẳng lan rộng khắp xứ.
vi.R: Hắn sẽ không giàu mãi, và của cải hắn sẽ không còn lâu. \q Đất đai của hắn sẽ không trải rộng ra trong xứ.

ko.L: 그는 부유하지 못하고 그의 재물이 오래가지 못하며, \q 그들의 소유가 땅에 퍼지지 못한다.
ko.B: 그는 계속 부유하지 못하고, 그의 재산은 오래가지 못하며, \q 그의 소유는 온 땅에 퍼지지 못한다.
ko.R: 그는 계속 부자로 살지 못하고, 그의 재산도 오래가지 못한다. \q 그의 땅이 넓어지지도 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: their possessions: what they own
alternatives: their grain bending to the ground
decisions.reason: The word (minleh) is found only here, and its sense is not certain. Taken as "possession" or "gain", the line says the wicked person's property will not spread over the land. Other suggestions, with small changes to the letters, are "their full ears of grain will not bend to the ground" and "his shadow will not lengthen".

decisions.choice: their: the wicked as a group
decisions.reason: The Hebrew changes from "his" to "their", thinking for a moment of all the wicked. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: he will not become rich: he will not stay rich
decisions.reason: The verb (ashar) here means to grow or stay rich; the wicked has riches (verse 27), but they will not last.

decisions.choice: his
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the one figure of the portrait (m2); Literal keeps the Hebrew plural.

source.text: לֹֽא־יָס֨וּר׀מִנִּי־חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹֽ֭נַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝יָס֗וּר בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Not he will depart from darkness; his young shoot will dry up a flame, and he will depart by [the] breath of his mouth.

en.L: He will not depart from darkness; \q a flame will dry up his young shoots, \q and he will depart by [the] breath of his mouth.
en.B: He will not escape the darkness; \q a flame will wither his young shoots, \q and he will be swept away by the breath of God's mouth.
en.R: He will not escape from darkness. \q He will be like a plant whose new shoots are burned by fire. \q The breath from God's mouth will blow him away.

es.L: No se apartará de las tinieblas; \q una llama secará sus renuevos, \q y se apartará por [el] aliento de su boca.
es.B: No escapará de las tinieblas; \q una llama marchitará sus brotes, \q y el aliento de la boca de Dios lo arrastrará.
es.R: No escapará de la oscuridad. \q Será como una planta cuyos brotes nuevos quema el fuego. \q El soplo de la boca de Dios se lo llevará.

fr.L: Il ne s’écartera pas des ténèbres ; \q une flamme desséchera ses rejetons, \q et il s’écartera par [le] souffle de sa bouche.
fr.B: Il n’échappera pas aux ténèbres ; \q une flamme flétrira ses jeunes pousses, \q et le souffle de la bouche de Dieu l’emportera.
fr.R: Il n’échappera pas à l’obscurité. \q Il sera comme une plante dont le feu brûle les nouvelles pousses. \q Le souffle de la bouche de Dieu l’emportera.

sw.L: Hataondoka gizani; \q mwali wa moto utakausha machipukizi yake, \q naye ataondolewa kwa pumzi ya kinywa chake.
sw.B: Hataepuka giza; \q mwali wa moto utanyausha machipukizi yake, \q naye atapeperushwa na pumzi ya kinywa cha Mungu.
sw.R: Hataepuka giza. \q Atakuwa kama mmea ambao machipukizi yake mapya yameunguzwa na moto. \q Pumzi ya kinywa cha Mungu itampeperusha mbali.
